socialEvents.description: Hi Sol, I'm Moss. I'm heading to the meadow roots near (14.84, 18.71) to collect some food and rest nearby. I'd enjoy some company if you'd like to join me somewhere with room beside the patch. How are you doing?
I'm well, thank you. The first berry bush is crowded, so I'm going west to the berries near (10.37, 16.12) for food and rest. I'd enjoy company later; let's leave each other room to gather.

Thanks, Sol. I've collected roots and rested. I'll come to the open space east of you, around (12.5, 16.5), leaving your berry patch clear. I'd enjoy hearing what you'd like to do next, or simply resting nearby together.

Quiet company sounds lovely. I'm eating a few berries and resting here, west of your proposed spot. I think of this patch as Westward Lanterns. Once I've recovered, I'd enjoy looking for a beautiful place together, without rushing or crowding the food plants.

I've gathered meadow roots and eaten; I know they provide 14 nutrition with no toxicity. I'm moving to open space near (12.5, 16.5) for company with Sol. I'd enjoy helping with shelter when you know what materials or work would be useful. What have you found?

Westward Lanterns has its name now. I'm rested and taking a short walk northwest toward the berries at (8.66, 14.19), to look closely rather than gather more. You're welcome to join me at a little distance; no need to share a standing spot or hurry.

The western berries are plentiful here. I'm continuing toward the hazelnut plant at (5.4, 12.5), just to look, then resting nearby. I like the idea of calling this western corner Low Amber. Quiet company is still welcome, with room for each of us.
